track_2.slow_section: race time 17.60 through 25.60; repeated center/outside-biased hairpins

video_diagnostic.interpretation: The replay supports late/center-biased cornering as a target for investigation, but it does not calibrate tire clearance or prove an optimal apex.

safety_review.finding: The isolated preview left +/-0.05 steering history that reduced an immediately opposing obstacle command to magnitude 0.02 instead of the distant-obstacle control's 0.07.
safety_review.decision: Do not route the isolated anticipatory class. Require anticipatory-obstacle-transition-priority-v1 and route only agent._ObstaclePriorityController.
safety_review.resolution: The composed controller restores mirrored straight and curve+obstacle opposing transitions to the distant-obstacle control action while preserving same-direction and non-obstacle transitions.

limitations: The implementation previews the distant road center; it is not a calibrated outside-inside-outside racing line and does not target the road edge.
An always-inside bias and track-specific apex memory were rejected as unsafe and unsupported by the available runtime contract.
The isolated preview is not safe to route without the registered obstacle-transition guard.
No environment execution measured a Track 1 or Track 2 time change, so the candidate remains INCOMPARABLE.
